project.summary: The task tree has two dimensions: (1) Process — how we work: source discovery → feature extraction → spec generation → replay implementation → execution → model feedback. Each process step carries knowledge about the methodology. (2) Domain — what we know: per-feature understanding of AKS behavior, organized by feature family. Domain knowledge currently lives in model/knowledge-map/model.json and features/*.yaml. Future: domain branches in the tree for deeper per-feature exploration. When a task is accepted, it gains knowledge. When archived, execution detail is lost but knowledge rolls up to the parent. Any branch can be reopened for deeper exploration.
